exposure: severe CKD or AKI in pregnancy
cohort: 50 pregnant patients with AKI (n=38) or advanced CKD (n=12) and 42 pregnant patients with mild kidney impairment (serum creatinine 0.8-1 mg/dL)
finding: Severe kidney function impairment during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, small for gestational age infants, lower Apgar scores, more frequent neonatal intensive care unit admissions, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery is more likely in patients with highly reduced kidney function.
